answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 23061 Country: India Title: Is it write or wrong that MAUZOO hadith are present in FAZAILE-AMAAL? Question: Is it write or wrong that MAUZOO hadith are present in FAZAILE-AMAAL? Answer ID: 23061 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 973/749/D=1431) The one who said that the hadith of Fazail Amal are mauzoo he told a lie made accusation. Of course, some hadith are weak, but they can be relied and practiced in the chapter of virtues as per the view of the majority of Hadith scholars. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
